_readme: Slash Trails settings. Also in game: Mods > Slash Trails > Config (Fabric: with Mod Menu). theme: classic, toxic, rainbow, neon, spooky, hologram, frost, cosmic, arcade, horror, ink, ashfall, storm. colorSource: theme (the theme's colours; Classic follows the weapon), material, enchantment, custom (customColor). intensity/width/length/opacity: 0-3. weapons: per weapon type, enabled and theme (or 'same'). items: item id -> sword, axe, trident, spear, mace, tool, hand, other or none, for modded weapons. hideVanillaSweep: hide the game's grey sweep particle (off by default). forceWithCombatMods: draw trails even with Better Combat or Epic Fight installed (they have their own).
